data.name: DREAD RULER
data.detailed_description:
DREAD RULER is a top-down dark fantasy action RPG where you cut through hordes of enemies, grow stronger after each battle, and challenge powerful ruler-class bosses waiting at the end of each stage.

Fight through dark forests, graveyards, ruins, and monster-infested battlefields. Defeat waves of goblins, skeletons, orcs, mages, and other enemies, then strengthen your skills after combat to shape your own build. Each battle pushes you closer to the final threat: a massive boss with overwhelming power.

Key Features

  • Hack-and-slash combat against hordes of enemies

  • Skill upgrades and build choices after each battle

  • Fast-paced top-down action focused on PvE combat

  • A dark fantasy world filled with monsters, ruins, and undead armies

  • Giant ruler-class bosses waiting at the end of each stage

  • Single-player gameplay built around combat, growth, and repeated challenges

Slay enemies, gain power, and challenge the ruler ahead.
In the world of DREAD RULER, surviving is not enough.
Only those who defeat the ruler can move on to the next battlefield.

data.short_description: DREAD RULER is a top-down dark fantasy action RPG where you cut through hordes of monsters, build your skills after each battle, and challenge giant ruler-class bosses. Slay, grow, and fight your way through a brutal PvE hack-and-slash world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended
